title: spec/lint: relatedLists' .describe() promises to refuse an entry that matches no inbound relationship, but a package-closure publish stores it (validate-related-list-refs judges unknown children only under wholeCollection)
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

## Observed (main after PR #27215, measured on the showcase app from PR #27303's branch)

`ObjectSchema.relatedLists`'s `.describe()` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, the #27069 block) says: an entry that matches no inbound `lookup` / `master_detail` field of this object is refused. On a Studio package publish (`PUT /api/v1/meta/object/desk_customer?mode=draft`, then the package publish) a stored `relatedLists: ['nope', 'desk_ticket']` was accepted and persisted with no refusal. `packages/lint/src/validate-related-list-refs.ts` judges an unknown child only under `wholeCollection`, which a package-closure publish does not set; the rule's header documents that boundary as deliberate (a downstream package's child may point in).

The Studio editor from PR #27303 closes the Studio half (its pre-write check never writes such an entry), so this is about the contract text versus the gate for every other writer: a stack author, a generated app, a direct API write.

## Reach

Public door: the metadata API's object write + package publish; also `defineStack` compile if the same gate runs there. Measured once on the showcase app (see PR #27303's report comment 6473641463 on #27054).

## Options for the spec lane

A. By design: keep the gate's boundary and reword the `.describe()` to say what is enforced ("refused when the collection is whole; a package closure may name a child a downstream package contributes"), so the contract text does not promise a refusal the runtime does not make.
B. Enforce: judge an unknown child at package-closure publish too, with the downstream-package case carried by an explicit declaration.

The seat does not rule this: it is a published contract's wording versus its gate. Governing text: `.describe()` of `relatedLists`; `packages/lint` `validate-related-list-refs` header; AGENTS.md "declared is enforced".

## Dedupe words

relatedLists unknown child publish accepted package closure wholeCollection validate-related-list-refs describe

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-28 from PR #27303's out-of-scope findings (class b, reach measured), under epic #26676.</sub>
